text:
Maya (Design): quick design check-in for the Private / VPC setup wizard 11 focusing on the networking step. i've pushed new frames to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzzzz. main goals: single-page readiness summary, clear next steps for failing checks, concise copy, and a11y tweaks for the form. attaching notes here.

Leo (Product): skimmed the frames. i like the consolidated "Network readiness" card. two asks: 1) make failure CTA explicit (e.g., 'Fix firewall rules') not just 'Learn more', 2) show ETA per check (Expected: ~3 min). users hate guessing.

Noor (Eng-Platform): on the preflight checklist: we should actually run these probes from the agent and surface statuses. recommended checks: outbound TLS to control-plane (api.redwood.ai:443), DNS resolution, NTP, KMS reachability. add a persisted "Re-run checks" button so ops can iterate.

Sam (SRE): +1. also include a small expandable "Proxy / Egress" help panel with example env vars and curl thru-proxy tips for corp networks. corp infra often requires proxy instructions.

Maya (Design): for failure copy, proposal: "Network validation failed 1 Required: outbound access to api.redwood.ai:443. Click 'How to fix' for step-by-step instructions." shorter version for banner: "Network validation failed 1 action required." thoughts?

Leo (Product): good. also prefer the success text to be explicit: "Network validated 1 Ready to provision."

Noor (Eng-Platform): UX nit: when checks are running, show a persistent spinner + 'Validating network...' and disable Next. but keep the detailed logs visible in a collapsible panel (don't use a modal). logs should be copy-safe.

Sam (SRE): agree on logs. include safe sample commands users can run locally:
```
# test TLS connectivity
curl -I https://api.redwood.ai/healthcheck
# test DNS
getent hosts api.redwood.ai || nslookup api.redwood.ai
```
these are actionable without revealing sensitive data. redact any ARNs/account IDs in UI.

Maya (Design): will include those snippets as collapsible "Debug commands". accessibility notes: use role="group" and aria-describedby on checkbox sets, ensure focus moves to the first error after validation, and improve color contrast on banners. also add keyboard-only focus styles for the re-run button.

Noor (Eng-Platform): operational question 1 do we let users skip automated provisioning for flagged endpoints like internal S3 or on-prem KV? i'd add a 'Manual setup' mode (with a clear warning and a checklist) so advanced users can proceed without automation.

Sam (SRE): yes, but surface strong warnings and require an explicit confirmation (checkbox) before skipping. also provide example iptables rules in the docs appendix; i can draft those.

infra-bot: Preflight checks queued: network-tls, dns-resolve, ntp-sync, kms-reach. Report: https://internal.redwood/checks/1748712345

Maya (Design): thanks all. i'll iterate the Figma with failure CTAs, the debug snippets, manual-setup toggle, and the accessibility fixes. i'll post the new frames when they're in staging. react with :eyes: if you want a ping when deployed.

Leo (Product): :eyes: ping me when it's in staging.

Noor (Eng-Platform): :+1: include telemetry event names for rerun (private.setup.preflight.rerun) and manual-skip (private.setup.manual.skip).

Sam (SRE): i'll add the firewall appendix and sample debug commands to docs. keep the logs limited to statuses and safe commands.

Maya (Design): closing the loop 1 will update and share a follow-up thread.
